title: Argentine temporary residence by nationality for native nationals of Mercosur member and associated states

sources.title: Ley 25.871, article 23, l): temporary residence by nationality for native citizens of the Mercosur states parties, Chile and Bolivia, for two years, extendable, with multiple entries and exits
Ley 25.871, article 23, ñ): temporary residence for the spouse, parent, or unmarried child under 18 not emancipated or adult child with a disability, of a temporary or permanent resident
Ley 25.871, article 10: the State guarantees family reunification of immigrants with their parents, spouses, unmarried minor children or adult children with a disability
Ley 25.871, article 29, b): an entry ban in force bars entry and stay until it is revoked or its term has run
Ley 25.871, article 63: an expulsion for an intentional crime carries a permanent ban on reentry, which cannot be lifted for crimes on life, sexual integrity or the constitutional order
Ley 25.871, article 29, c), and closing paragraphs: conviction, final or not, formal charge or committal for trial, for a crime Argentine law punishes with three years or more; the dispensation, bars
Ley 25.871, article 29, d), and closing paragraphs: a conviction, final or not, for a crime Argentine law punishes with less than three years of prison; the exceptional dispensation and its bars
Ley 25.871, article 29, a) and e) to l): the other grounds that bar entry and stay
Ley 25.871, articles 34 and 123 bis: entry only through authorized posts; the sworn statement of purpose and health insurance applies once its implementation is regulated
Ley 25.871, article 8: outside emergencies, national public health services give a non-permanent resident routine care only against health insurance or prior payment
Ley 25.871, article 62, e): a temporary residence is cancelled after six months or more outside Argentina, save the exceptions it names
Decreto 616/2010, article 23, l): the states named in article 23, l), of the law are illustrative, and every Mercosur state party and associated state counts
Decreto 616/2010, article 23, last paragraph: temporary residence for the spouse, parent, or unmarried child under 18 not emancipated or adult child with a disability, of a temporary resident
Decreto 616/2010, article 20, c): a foreigner with a disability, whatever their age, gets the same residence category as their parents, children or spouse
Decreto 616/2010, article 29: a record or conviction abroad counts only when the act is a crime under Argentine law
Decreto 366/2025, article 6: adds article 23, ñ) (family reunification) to Ley 25.871, in force from its publication on 2025-05-29 (article 47)
Disposición DNM 1637/2022, annex, article 2: natives of 11 Mercosur states, and nationals naturalized for five years or more in Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador or Colombia
Disposición DNM 1637/2022, annex, article 4, a): what an applicant under article 23, l), of the law must show and sign
Dirección Nacional de Migraciones: who can apply for temporary residence by nationality (Mercosur), applying from inside Argentina, for at most two years, extendable
Disposición DNM 4880/2015, article 1: a cohabiting union registered in the local registry counts like a marriage for admission with a temporary or permanent resident
Disposición DNM 6206/2017, article 1: the current wording of article 1 of Disposición DNM 4880/2015 on registered cohabiting unions
Civil and Commercial Code (Ley 26.994), articles 25 and 27: a minor has not turned 18, and marriage before 18 emancipates, irrevocably
Civil and Commercial Code (Ley 26.994), articles 510, 511 and 512: a cohabiting union needs two unmarried adults living together for two years; its registration serves only as proof
Decreto 584/2024, article 2: the migration services unit (UMSM) is worth ARS 1,000; article 3 lets the Chief of Cabinet change it
Decreto 584/2024, article 5, II: unmarried children under 18 who apply together with a parent pay no residence fee
Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, fee table under Decreto 584/2024: permanent or temporary residence costs 50 UMSM in the Mercosur column and 100 UMSM in the other
Registro Nacional de Reincidencia: the criminal record certificate costs ARS 1,000 for delivery in 5 days, more for faster delivery
Disposición DNM 1637/2022, annex, article 4, b): the other categories of article 23 add, to the papers of article 4, a), those proving the ground invoked
Disposición DNM 1637/2022, annex, article 6: an applicant under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's authorization signed before a migration officer and a legalized birth certificate
Disposición DNM 1637/2022, annex, article 7: each paper in detail: identity, lawful entry, criminal records, family records, legalization, translation, disability

requirements.title: Native national of a Mercosur member or associated state the migration directorate lists, or naturalized for five years or more in one of the eight states it lists for that

assessments.title: No conviction, final or not, even suspended, or formal charge (procesamiento) or committal for trial, anywhere, for a crime Argentine law punishes with 3 years of prison or more, save a dispensation
No conviction, final or not, even suspended, in Argentina or abroad, for a crime Argentine law punishes with less than 3 years of prison, save an exceptional dispensation
No conviction or record, of any penalty, for an intentional crime against life, sexual integrity, or the public powers and constitutional order: no dispensation is possible
No ban on entering Argentina in force, unless revoked or run out; expulsion for an intentional crime bans reentry for good, for a crime on life, sex or the constitutional order with no dispensation
None of article 29's other bars: false papers or hidden records, fraud, flagrante delicto, international or terror crimes, migrant smuggling, irregular entry, false purpose, extradition
In Argentina, apply online after a lawful entry through an authorized post (the sworn statement of purpose and health insurance applies once regulated); from abroad, at a consulate (not modeled)
Papers: identity document, proof of lawful entry and of an address; from 16, criminal record certificates of Argentina and of each country lived in over 1 year in the last 3 years; sworn statement
Until permanent residence, routine care in health services the national State runs needs health insurance or prior payment, outside emergencies

dependents.title: Partner of two years or more, both adults and unmarried, who counts like a spouse only if the union is registered, which is not recorded: possible
Unmarried children under 18; adult children only with a disability, which is not recorded: possible

The spouse's children, whom article 23, ñ), does not name: they qualify as the spouse's own children once the spouse is a resident, which is not modeled: possible; a married child under 18 is left out

The partner's children, whom article 23, ñ), does not name, if the principal is unmarried and the union of two years or more is registered, not recorded: possible; a married child under 18 is left out

costs.title: Residence fee in the Mercosur and associated states column: 50 UMSM, at ARS 1,000 a unit, paid when applying in Argentina
Residence fee of each family member, unless an unmarried child under 18 applying with a parent: 50 UMSM, at ARS 1,000 a unit, the lower of the table's two columns
Further fee of each family member who is not a native of a listed state, if the table's 100 UMSM column applies, which it does not say: 50 UMSM more, at ARS 1,000 a unit: possible
Argentina's criminal record certificate, from age 16, if got outside the online system, as with a preferential appointment: ARS 1,000 for delivery in 5 days, more if faster: possible
The same certificate for each family member aged 16 or more, if got outside the online system: ARS 1,000 for delivery in 5 days, more if faster: possible

durations.title: Temporary residence by nationality: two years, extendable, with multiple entries and exits; among other grounds, cancelled after six months or more abroad, save exceptions

documents.title: Proof of paying the migration services fee, or of falling under one of its exemptions
documents.note: In the online system (RaDEX), the fees are paid on the platform itself

documents.title: Valid, current identity document: a passport, another document in annex I of the Mercosur travel documents agreement, or a consulate's nationality certificate with a photo
documents.note: Legible and unaltered, any amendment validated by its issuer; its names are the ones used for the residence and the DNI

documents.title: Proof of lawful entry into Argentina: the entry card or the passport stamped by the migration authority, or the record in the national entry and exit registry
Proof of an address in the area of the migration directorate's office that handles the application
Argentine criminal record certificate from the Registro Nacional de Reincidencia, from age 16
documents.note: Included in RaDEX, with no separate request; got outside it, as with a preferential appointment, it is valid 90 days from issue

documents.title: From age 16, a criminal record certificate from each country lived in for over 1 year in the last 3 years, showing no convictions or pending criminal proceedings
documents.note: Apostille or consular legalization; a public translator's translation unless in Spanish or a Brazilian paper in Portuguese

documents.title: Sworn statement of having no international criminal record, signed by the applicant
For an applicant under 18: a legalized birth certificate proving the family link
documents.note: Apostille or consular legalization if issued abroad; a public translator's translation unless in Spanish or a Brazilian record in Portuguese

documents.title: For an applicant under 18: the authorization of one parent or the guardian, signed before a migration officer
documents.note: The adult who signs shows their own valid, current identity document

documents.title: For an applicant under 18 whose parents are not in Argentina: the public instrument appointing a guardian, who must be a legal resident of Argentina
documents.note: Issued abroad: apostille, or legalization by an Argentine consulate or, for a Mercosur paper, by the issuer's consulate in Argentina
